title: Cy Twombly: Ausgewählte Fotografien / Selected Photographs 1944–2006

description.main: Catalogue of 35 photographs by Cy Twombly, dated 1944 to 2006, from a Munich private collection, published for the 2016 exhibition at Museum Frieder Burda, Baden-Baden. With an essay by Helmut Friedel in German and English.
description.extended:
A slim bilingual catalogue of 35 photographs by Cy Twombly from the Munich collection of his publisher Lothar Schirmer, issued for the 2016 exhibition at Museum Frieder Burda in Baden-Baden, with pictures dated from 1944 to 2006.

The exhibition ran from 11 June to 9 October 2016. Helmut Friedel, who edited the book for the Stiftung Frieder Burda, contributes the essay Stille Präsenz (A Quiet Presence), printed in German and English. He begins with a 1944 photograph of the artist in Ogunquit, Maine, in front of Charles Woodbury's easel, moves to the pictures made in Robert Rauschenberg's Fulton Street studio in the 1950s, and then turns to the later peonies and roses. Colour plates of the exhibited works follow, among them interiors, landscapes, and details of Twombly's own sculptures and paintings.

Twombly (1928–2011) took photographs from his student days onward and began publishing them in volume only late in his career. Schirmer/Mosel's larger books, Photographs II 1951–2007, Photographs III 1951–2010 and Unpublished Photographs IV, document that work at length. This 72-page volume gives a representative selection.
description.artist_bio: Cy Twombly (1928–2011), American painter, sculptor and photographer. The Cy Twombly Foundation maintains his bibliography and exhibition history.
